title: trema guineense
intro: Trema guineense, commonly known as West African lemon, is a plant species in the family Cannabaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Trema guineense are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its analgesic, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Trema guineense include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
